teaser.en: Its name means 'to calm', and it is used to settle quarrels between lovers as well as to treat malaria.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kutuliza', na hutumika kusuluhisha ugomvi kati ya wapenzi pamoja na kutibu malaria.

summary.en: *Mtserere* is an aromatic shrub of the bush and fallow with small orange fruits. The Digo boil its roots for malaria and use it to calm quarrels between lovers.
summary.sw: *Mtserere* ni kichaka chenye harufu nzuri cha porini na mashamba yaliyoachwa, chenye matunda madogo ya rangi ya chungwa. Wadigo huchemsha mizizi yake kwa ajili ya malaria na hukitumia kutuliza ugomvi kati ya wapenzi.

about.en: *Mtserere* is a scented shrub of the mint family, with leaves in opposite pairs that smell when crushed. It carries small, fleshy orange fruits, bright little beads among the leaves.
about.sw: *Mtserere* ni kichaka chenye harufu cha familia ya minanaa, chenye majani yaliyokaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana ambayo hutoa harufu yakipondwa. Huzaa matunda madogo yenye nyama ya rangi ya chungwa, kama shanga ndogo zinazong'aa katikati ya majani.

where.en: It grows in the bush, on fallow land and on forest edges.
where.sw: Hukua porini, katika mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike na pembezoni mwa misitu.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the roots to treat malaria. It is also used to calm quarrels between lovers.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi yake kutibu malaria. Pia hutumika kutuliza ugomvi kati ya wapenzi.

culture.en: The name comes from *tserera*, 'bring down' or 'calm', which matches its use in cooling tempers between lovers.
culture.sw: Jina lake linatokana na *tserera*, 'kushusha' au 'kutuliza', jambo linalolingana na matumizi yake ya kupoza hasira kati ya wapenzi.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names. *Mtserere* is shared with Giriama and Swahili, and *mgongolo* with Duruma. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Hoslundia opposita*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo. *Mtserere* ni jina linalotumika pia kwa Kigiriama na Kiswahili, na *mgongolo* kwa Kiduruma. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Hoslundia opposita*.

reason.en: Plectranthus, an aromatic herb of the same family
reason.sw: Plectranthus, mmea wenye harufu wa familia ile ile

reason.en: African basil, an aromatic medicinal relative
reason.sw: Mrihani, jamaa mwenye harufu anayetumika kama dawa

reason.en: Bush shrub whose roots are also boiled for malaria
reason.sw: Mchinjiri, kichaka cha porini ambacho mizizi yake pia huchemshwa kwa ajili ya malaria
